specification.problem: Evaluate a Boolean formula built from binary NAND gates over N input variables using a discrete-query quantum algorithm; the abstract claims O(sqrt(N)) queries for balanced formulas and N^{1/2+O(1/sqrt(log N))} queries for arbitrary formulas.
specification.reconstruction_scope: Define the NAND formula evaluation problem and the stated query complexities, plus a tiny explicit instance (depth-2 balanced formula on N=4 inputs). The actual discrete-query algorithm (walk/span-program construction, unitaries, phase estimation or any subroutine) is outside scope and not reconstructed.
